subject_line: Tallow, Meatstock, and Your Summer Meal Plan
opening: Happy Monday, carnivores. This week we've got everything from a 1,600-person convention recap to the science behind your grandma's favorite cooking fat. Grab your coffee, maybe fry an egg in some tallow, and let's get into it.

blog_teasers.title: Carnivore and Alcohol: What Happens When You Drink
blog_teasers.teaser: If you've noticed two drinks hitting like four since going carnivore, you're not imagining it. Sarah breaks down exactly what's happening in your liver when alcohol meets a fat-fueled metabolism. It's not bad news, but you'll definitely want to know before your next weekend plans.

blog_teasers.title: Meatstock 2026: What 1,600 Carnivores in One Room Looks Like
blog_teasers.teaser: Fads don't fill convention halls. Movements do, and Meatstock 2026 just proved carnivore is very much a movement. Chloe was there for all of it and her recap will honestly make you wish you'd bought a ticket.

blog_teasers.title: Carnivore Recomp: Losing Fat and Building Muscle at the Same Time
blog_teasers.teaser: Most people think recomposition is reserved for beginners or people on gear. Marcus is here to tell you that's wrong, and he's got a 12-week carnivore protocol with exact protein targets to back it up. If you've been spinning your wheels, this is your next move.

blog_teasers.title: Your Personalized Carnivore Meal Plan for Summer
blog_teasers.teaser: A 30-day plan built around your actual macros, not some generic template someone copy-pasted from a forum. Sarah's included grocery lists, simple meals, and summer sale pricing that won't last long. This one's worth clicking on before the week gets away from you.

blog_teasers.title: What Beef Tallow Actually Does (And Why It's Trending)
blog_teasers.teaser: Tallow went from forgotten pantry staple to one of the most talked-about fats on the internet, and Sarah explains exactly why the hype is actually backed by science. Your grandmother cooked with it every day and she wasn't wrong. Here's the full story.

whats_trending:
Tallow Everything. Beef tallow is having a serious moment right now. People are cooking with it, skincare brands are putting it in moisturizers, and grocery stores can't keep it stocked. The old ways are coming back fast.

Carnivore Summer Prep. With summer officially here, the community's big focus is keeping it simple outdoors. Grilled ribeyes, beach-friendly snacks like biltong and hard-boiled eggs, and no-fuss meal plans are dominating the conversation this week.

Sober-ish Carnivore. More people in the community are questioning alcohol entirely after noticing how much worse it hits on a meat-based diet. The "carnivore sober curious" crowd is growing, and it's a conversation worth watching.
community_pulse: Something that keeps coming up in our community emails and forums this week is how much better people's sleep has gotten after six to eight weeks on carnivore. We're hearing it over and over. It's not just anecdote either. When blood sugar stabilizes and inflammatory foods come out of the picture, your body gets a real chance to rest deeply. If you're newer and still waiting for that benefit, hang tight. It tends to show up right around the six-week mark for most people.
looking_ahead: Next week we're going deep on training frequency for carnivore athletes. Specifically, how many days you can actually push hard when you're fueling on protein and fat with zero carb buffer. I've also got some numbers from our community survey on strength gains at the 90-day mark that might surprise you. Don't miss it.
